cases.sentence: ___ вошел в дом Божий и ел священный хлеб, который нельзя есть никому, кроме священников, а также дал его своим людям.
cases.translation: David entered the house of God and ate the sacred bread, which no one may eat except the priests, and also gave it to his men.
cases.explain: Давид is the subject of вошел (entered) — nominative.

cases.sentence: Проходя, Иисус увидел Левия, сына ___, сидевшего на месте сбора таможенных пошлин.
cases.translation: As he passed by, Jesus saw Levi, son of Alphaeus, sitting at the tax collection booth.

cases.sentence: Иисус опять вышел к ___. Весь народ шел к нему, и он учил их.
cases.translation: Jesus went out again beside the lake. All the crowd came to him, and he taught them.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) takes the dative → озеру.

cases.sentence: Проходя, Иисус увидел ___, сына Алфея, сидевшего на месте сбора таможенных пошлин.
cases.translation: As he passed by, Jesus saw Levi, son of Alphaeus, sitting at the tax collection booth.
cases.explain: Увидел (saw) takes a direct object; Левий is animate, so the accusative matches the genitive: Левия.

cases.sentence: Учители закона из фарисеев увидели, что он ест вместе с ___ и сборщиками налогов
cases.translation: The teachers of the law who were Pharisees saw that he was eating with sinners and tax collectors.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → грешниками.

cases.translation: This happened in the days of the high priest Abiathar.
cases.explain: The preposition при (in the time of) takes the prepositional → первосвященнике.

reading.ru: они поднялись на крышу, разобрали ее и спустили сверху циновку, на которой лежал больной.
reading.question: How did the four men bring the paralyzed man to Jesus?
options: They lowered him through the roof on a mat
They carried him through the front door
They waited outside until Jesus came out
reading.correct: They lowered him through the roof on a mat
reading.explain: Since the crowd blocked the door, they went up on the roof, opened it, and lowered the mat with the paralyzed man.

reading.ru: Кто, кроме Бога, может прощать грехи?
reading.question: What objection did the teachers of the law raise in their hearts?
options: Jesus was not a real healer
The man was not truly paralyzed
Jesus had no right to teach
reading.explain: They reasoned that only God can forgive sins, so Jesus' words seemed blasphemous to them.

reading.ru: Больной тут же, на глазах у всех, встал, взял циновку и вышел.
reading.question: What did the paralyzed man do after Jesus told him to get up?
options: He stood up, took his mat, and walked out
He asked to stay and rest
He argued with the teachers of the law
reading.correct: He stood up, took his mat, and walked out
reading.explain: In front of everyone, the man got up, took his mat, and went out.

reading.ru: «Следуй за мной», — сказал ему Иисус. Тот встал и пошел за ним.
reading.question: How did Levi respond when Jesus called him?
options: He got up and followed Jesus
He asked for time to think
reading.correct: He got up and followed Jesus
reading.explain: When Jesus said “Follow me,” Levi got up and followed him.

reading.ru: «Не здоровым нужен врач, а больным. Я пришел призвать не праредников, а грешников».
reading.question: How did Jesus explain why he ate with sinners?
options: He compared himself to a physician needed by the sick, not the healthy
He said the Pharisees were worse sinners
He denied eating with sinners at all
reading.correct: He compared himself to a physician needed by the sick, not the healthy
reading.explain: Jesus said it is not the healthy who need a doctor but the sick, and he came to call sinners.

reading.ru: И никто не наливает молодое вино в старые бурдюки, иначе вино прорвет их, тогда и вино пропадет, и бурдюки.
reading.question: What image did Jesus use to explain why new practices don't fit old forms?
options: A tree that bears no fruit
reading.explain: Jesus said no one puts new wine into old wineskins, or the wine will burst them.

reading.ru: Суббота создана для человека, а не человек для субботы
reading.question: What did Jesus teach about the purpose of the Sabbath?
options: The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath
Only priests may rest on the Sabbath
The Sabbath is more important than people
reading.correct: The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath
reading.explain: Jesus concluded that the Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
